To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the stability of chocolates can be controlled by tuning the fat phase composition, in particular the TAG profile.
the stability of chocolates towards heat induced melting, fat bloom and oil migration can be controlled through the incorporation of StOSt rich mango fats.
the incorporation of StOSt rich mango fats into chocolate can be used to improve the heat stability and the stability towards fat bloom development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the functionality of soft and hard stearic acid (StOSt) rich fats for chocolate applications under tropical conditions.
the development of heat resistant chocolates, with improved fat bloom stability.
the development of heat resistant and fat bloom resistant filled chocolates, suitable for tropical and non tropical conditions, respectively.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CB/VMF (or CB/IMFSt) is the best fat blend for heat resistant dark chocolate with increased fat stability, while CB/IMFOL is suitable for chocolate applications in temperate conditions.
by tuning the TAG composition of the fat phase, the heat resistance and fat bloom stability of dark chocolate can be improved.
the incorporation of StOSt rich fat in the chocolate fat phase increases the heat resistance and fat bloom stability of the dark chocolate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CB/IMF 70/70 is suitable for chocolate applications in the tropics and CB/VMFst 70 30 and CB/VMFOl 90 10 are suitable for non tropical applications.

the addition of hard and soft stearin rich fats (CB + VMF 70/ 30, CB+IMFst 80/ 20, CB + IMFol 90/ 10) increases the fat bloom stability of dark chocolate, while retaining the quality attributes (colour and hardness), compared to CB.
by tuning the TAG composition several fat blends of CB and StOSt rich fat can be obtained with improved stability against heat resistance, oil migration and fat bloom.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the incorporation of StOSt rich mango fats into chocolate formulations is a promising strategy to improve the heat resistance and fat bloom stability of chocolates.
the use of soft and hard mango fat blends can be a suitable alternative to CB in tropical countries.
by tuning the TAG composition in a fat phase formulation, the heat resistance and fat bloom stability of chocolates can be increased.
